content: SQLite WAL best practice (sqlite.org/wal.html + practitioners): set busy_timeout on every connection (5000ms common), BEGIN IMMEDIATE for write transactions (deferred read-to-write upgrade returns SQLITE_BUSY immediately regardless of timeout), keep write txns milliseconds-short, WAL is persistent per-file, wal_autocheckpoint bounds WAL growth, short-lived reader processes can hit BUSY during recovery/cleanup windows so retry logic on open remains necessary.
